justification: Closes with an explicit one-sentence root cause naming both halves: 'after offlineSplitParent empties the parent row's server column (CatalogWriter.java:80-83), the master's dead-server recovery cannot see the parent anymore (filtered at CatalogScanner.java:578-580); consequently the recoverSplitChildren safety net at LostServerHandler.java:179-184 is dead code'. Its numbered table lists row 1 = CatalogWriter.java:80-83 writing SERVER_QUALIFIER/STARTCODE_QUALIFIER as EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY, row 4 = the `pair.getSecond() == null || !pair.getSecond().equals(hsi)` continue at CatalogScanner.java:578-580, row 5 = the unreachable `hri.isOffline() && hri.isSplit()` branch. It also correctly identifies the split's point-of-no-return window in SplitTransaction.execute between offlineSplitParent and the DaughterOpener/addSplitChild writes. Matches (a) and (b).
